identification: Pair of steel horse hames with chain, plus pair of cast iron fire dogs with small figural (owl or monkey-like) heads on wheeled bases. A small kangaroo in relief sits on a hame plate (photo 2), likely a maker's emblem, so possibly Australian-made. No legible name. Rusty, dirty, common types.

entries.note: Antique cast iron kangaroo doorstop, not hames. Database hit only (page not opened). Shows kangaroo-cast iron collectable only when a quality antique casting; a small stamped emblem on a hame adds little.

chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'cast iron fire dogs owl' ; 'andirons owl head cast iron pair' ; 'horse hames kangaroo' ; 'kangaroo hames harness Australian'; 'antique hames pair' . Also Leski, Theodore Bruce and Lawsons sold results for 'andirons kangaroo' and 'hames'. Check for a maker name behind the kangaroo emblem (e.g. kangaroo-branded harness makers).
viewing_check: Photograph the kangaroo emblem on the hame plate and look for any maker name, town or patent mark nearby. Check the fire dogs underside and back for maker marks, and whether the heads are owls (worth more) or monkeys/other, plus any cracks or repairs and height.
